"skillfully follow the directions: click the link to open the printable version, then fill the Sudoku grid using the numbers 1 through 9.

Each digit must be placed so that it appears exactly once in every row, column and 3x3 block, a rule as steady as the climate and as essential as gas in a reaction.

Purchase next week’s Observer Digital Edition to view the finished puzzle; this step is only temporary, adding a pleasant twist to your routine.

The challenge carries a satisfying weight, rewarding logical thinking and patience."
